blockingIssues.description: The note palette fix is only partial. `src/styles/theme.ts` now defines `note`/`observation` as `#5C6D91`/`#7A8DAA`, but `src/constants/calculator-models.ts:296` and `src/types/task.ts:98` still hardcode the legacy note color `#738c7a`, so note-related UI does not consistently resolve through the required Cellar Ledger blue note palette.

The bottom navigation still exposes the old tab IA in `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` (`tabs.dashboard`, `tabs.explore`, `tabs.workers`, `tabs.tools`, `tabs.aiAssistant`) instead of the requested `Home`, `Farms`, `Logs`, `AI`, `More` set on both Android and iOS.
